findings.title: Wrap owned RunBpmnState wrapper decoding at the native checkpoint boundary
findings.failure: A malformed owned inline RunBpmnState wrapper under a valid ActivityPrivateState envelope leaks raw JsonException through the public checkpoint committer when native cancellation reads its retained predecessor, without native execution or invocation context.
findings.sourceBoundary: Focused source9c in-process contract probe; relevant source trees equal reviewed d144; no actual-host corruption/recovery claim and no physical persistence calls.
findings.suggestedCorrection: Wrap typed wrapper decoding in the BPMN domain exception with native execution/invocation/node context and preserve the original JsonException as InnerException; retain the valid wire.
